text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr puts on a strong 
performance in the Aoi Stakes. When she 
replies to the cheers from the crowd after 
the race, the fans are left in awe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Tokai Teio conquers the 
Japanese Derby, becoming an undefeated 
Double Crown Umamusume. She is now one 
step away from her goal of becoming an 
"Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She refused to lose to her. Her next goal 
was a stage of the same grade as hers: the 
GⅠ race, the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, Yamanin Zephyr, who hadn't paid any 
attention to her surroundings back during 
her debut, suddenly wanted to know about 
her opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her horizons broadened through her 
interactions with Tokai Teio. But as a 
result, she came to realize the existence 
of two massive walls—
